# Pixel Tip Calculator

A retro pixel-art styled tip calculator built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Works fully offline in any modern browser.

## Features

- Enter bill amount and number of people
- Choose tip percentage (10%, 15%, 20%) via keyboard-accessible buttons
- Live calculation of tip amount and total per person
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Pixel-art aesthetic with blocky borders and stepped shadows

## How to Run

Open `index.html` directly in a browser. No server, build step, or network connection required.

## File Structure

- `index.html` — markup and structure
- `styles.css` — pixel-art theme and responsive layout
- `app.js` — calculation logic and interactivity
- `README.md` — this file

## Accessibility

- All inputs have visible labels
- Tip buttons use `aria-pressed` to indicate selection
- Results update in an `aria-live` region
- Visible focus rings on all interactive controls
- Full keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter/Space)

## Palette

- Background: `#1a1a2e`
- Card: `#16213e`
- Accent: `#e94560`
- Border: `#0f3460`
- Text: `#eaeaea`
